recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If follow-up is desired, update HL7/fhir-extensions input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-expression.xml so differential.element[id="Extension"].definition matches the corrected description and no longer says "understood to the make"; no current core FHIR source edit is indicated.
issue_request: FHIR-31489 asked to fix grammar errors in the valueset-expression extension text for R5, including clarifying the compose context, identifying the expression as this extension, and fixing the computable-format comment and rules-text cross-reference.
initial_application: Core commit 9fca6ca36f explicitly listed FHIR-31489 and changed source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-expression.xml; after that commit was reverted, 054eabf311 re-applied the valueset work. The historical application corrected the comment and added context, but left an ungrammatical definition phrase, "understood to the make," in the extension definition.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 later removed the valueset-expression StructureDefinition and ValueSet-core ImplementationGuide extension entries from R5 source. Current core source keeps ValueSet active but does not list valueset-expression as an active profile/resource; current ValueSet notes link to the Extension Pack. The maintained Extension Pack source has corrected top-level description wording while its differential root definition still contains stale grammar. Later issue FHIR-40704, already represented on the combined branch, audited the same ownership boundary and recommended Extension Pack cleanup.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no core source changes, because the current core build no longer owns the authoritative valueset-expression StructureDefinition source.
